coverageTaxonomy.coverageNote: Taxonomy is the end-to-end authoring target. Presence here is not authored coverage. Current units are representative teacher-review candidates; exact family/objective mapping must use their actual questions, not labels alone.

journey.action: Offer vocabulary, sentence meaning, language-control and instruction support by skill; no complete general-English course claim.
Use separate original short samples and record uncertainty, floor/ceiling, familiarity and conditions; no band placement.
AI teaches teacher-designed anchors and asks a purposeful check before feedback.
Attempt guided practice, explain evidence and repair.
Independent new-family work, fresh restricted context, no hints or answer guidance; teacher confirms family distinction.
Feedback ties to actual response; preserve frozen original and child revision. Same-family improvement is not fresh transfer.
Use realistic-length sections after prerequisite/skill training; retain declared timing and help conditions.
Complete four-skill form only after full media, interaction, timing and teacher approval gates.
Explain errors, prioritize repair and schedule teacher-defined later fresh checks; no optimal interval claim.

prerequisitePolicy.graph: Instruction literacy and sentence meaning support task comprehension; task-specific data/directions/argument knowledge connects to relevant activities.
prerequisitePolicy.nonBlocking: Learners may choose available challenge or another skill. Teacher evidence and learner preference override route suggestions, not privacy or unseen-family rules.
prerequisitePolicy.placement: Per-skill uncertain route suggestions; no single global ability label.

evidencePolicy.rawPracticeMarks: Only item/set accuracy under stated conditions.
evidencePolicy.expertFeedback: Requires named authorized assignment and actual human decision.
evidencePolicy.bands: No calibrated or official-sounding band estimates.
evidencePolicy.holdouts: Reserve genuinely different source semantic families. Same-family train/transfer or source-derived mocks cannot become unseen through paraphrase, ID or representation changes.
evidencePolicy.semanticExposure: Record actual semantic exposure group IDs per activity and unit. Any previous release in a group invalidates an unseen claim in every pathway or track; declared source refs/family IDs supplement, not replace, semantic audit.

knownGaps: No complete English prerequisite sequence or validated diagnostic placement.
No complete task-family-by-demand coverage, repeated section forms or equated unseen full-test progress forms.
Human IELTS content review and teacher identity pending.
No productive-rating calibration, model evaluation or learner efficacy evidence.
Active runtime currently supports its narrow existing Reading/Task2 integration; this manifest does not make all candidate tasks operational.
All four source levels are observed, but only selected lesson excerpts are deeply mapped; full34topic objective/lesson coverage is not complete.
Source-based training and mocks may share source semantics; teacher-approved family/exposure separation is required before any unseen claim.
Cambridge selected source questions are benchmarks of construct, not calibration of transformed tasks.

publisherPositioning.sourceStatement: Foundation is aimed at A2 learners thinking about IELTS; linear general-English development with appropriately introduced assessment.

observedLearningPoints: Use familiar daily activities to connect meaning, present-simple clauses and frequency expressions.
Use Reading to build ideas/language for Writing and Listening to prepare Speaking.
Introduce manageable assessment forms without pretending a beginner lesson is a full IELTS task.
sourceBasedObjectiveSequence.progression: Understand meaning → short controlled use → describe a real routine → explain and revise.
sourceBasedObjectiveSequence.coverage: Selected Unit1/course-configuration evidence; remaining foundation unit outcomes require further source inspection.

observedLearningPoints: Understand actual stringhopper preparation stages and equipment, then use present-simple passive to describe the process.
Distinguish an introduction from a process overview and choose sequencing language by stage order.
Apply the source sequence to its cherry-jam production practice without treating ingredient facts as invented.
sourceBasedObjectiveSequence.progression: Interpret source process/equipment → passive clauses → ordered stages → introduction/overview distinction → full process description and repair.
sourceBasedObjectiveSequence.coverage: Selected Level1 Unit1 process lesson; not all Level1 skill objectives.

observedLearningPoints: Read labels/units, identify key differences and trends, correct misreported source data.
Group significant features and produce an overview without speculative explanations.
Move from structured descriptions to a full150-word response.
sourceBasedObjectiveSequence.progression: Interpret actual source display → select key features → contrast flawed/correct statements → independently describe source-based adapted data.
sourceBasedObjectiveSequence.coverage: Selected graph lessons only, not all Task1 visual types.

observedLearningPoints: Brainstorm relevant advantages/disadvantages, select a main point and distinguish explanation/example/contrast.
Use discourse markers only where the relationship supports them.
Address actual housing or healthcare/life-expectancy source question demands and maintain a developed position.
sourceBasedObjectiveSequence.progression: Demand interpretation → main/supporting ideas → coherent paragraph → full essay → evidence-linked revision.
sourceBasedObjectiveSequence.coverage: Selected Task2 source families; not an exhaustive essay syllabus.

observedLearningPoints: Distinguish familiar personal questions, concrete long-turn experiences and general discussion.
Use one-minute notes for sustained speech, with flexible expansion rather than memorised answers.
Recognise comparison,prediction,hypothesis,cause and past/present functions; attend to sentence stress from actual audio when available.
sourceBasedObjectiveSequence.progression: Familiar local experience → planned concrete account → related abstract discussion → actual-audio review.
sourceBasedObjectiveSequence.coverage: Selected urban/rural and tourism source families; actual recordings/teacher judgement pending.

sourceBoundary.authority: Arash authorized source-based content and selected licensed excerpt processing on2026-11-06; no worldwide authority inferred.
sourceBoundary.heldDrafts: Source-free drafts are superseded/held. All current origin declarations are recorded separately from independent review and human teacher decisions. Unresolved source facts, semantic exposure or assets prevent accepted freeze and any learner/fresh-transfer claim.
sourceBoundary.publicAssets: No whole books, source page scans or bulk source text are included in the review corpus.
sourceBoundary.availability: This is source-based authoring/reviewer material; it is not a teacher-approved learner course.

semanticExposureMappingStatus: Complete exact per-question author mappings for all36 units, hash-bound to final authored raw bytes; global unseen status remains unestablished until actual exposure-ledger checks.

corpusSelectionPolicy.identity: Select by actual source-semantic group, objective, task family and declared condition; IDs are references, not independence evidence.
corpusSelectionPolicy.exposure: Release of a complete passage/script/stimulus exposes its whole semantic group union even when some questions are unanswered.
corpusSelectionPolicy.unseen: Any prior actual semantic group exposure across pathways/tracks excludes unseen admission; unresolved group assignment fails closed.
corpusSelectionPolicy.revision: Versions/hashes pin content and source policy; a new filename or paraphrase cannot erase exposure.
corpusSelectionPolicy.bank: Whole-corpus retrieval must use these same semantic exclusions, not only current36 unit IDs.
